pushNotificationsEnableGuide.title: How to enable or disable Push Notifications on Chrome, Firefox & Safari Browser?
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.intro: Do not want to receive a push notification from a website you subscribed earlier?
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.introBody: Here is a quick guide to Disable Web Push Notifications on desktop and mobile. Follow these simple steps to disable notification from an unwanted website.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.desktopHeading: How to Enable/ Disable Web Push Service on Desktop
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.chromeSubheading: See how you can enable or disable web push notification in Chrome
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.chromeStep1a: Open Chrome browser and follow the given path or simply type-
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.chromeStep2a: A pop-up window with content setting will be displayed.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.chromeStep3: In this section a list of website URL, you have subscribed for will appear. Select the website URL you want to unsubscribe. Here you can allow, deny or completely delete a website URL.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.firefoxSubheading: Check how you can enable or disable web push notification in Firefox
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.firefoxStep1: Open Mozilla Firefox browser, then go to Firefox menu and select options.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.firefoxStep2: Select the content segment and tap on the choose button under Notifications.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.firefoxStep3: A Notification Permissions window will pop-up. In this section, select the site URL’s you wish to unsubscribe. Then click on Remove Site.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.firefoxNote1: To stop all sites from sending push messages, click Remove All Sites.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.firefoxNote2: Websites will need to ask your permission to send messages in the future.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.safariSubheading: Check out how to enable or disable web push from a particular website on Safari Browser
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.safariStep1: Open your Safari browser and click on Safari. Under Safari panel click on Preferences.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.safariStep2: Select the website you wish to remove from notification section. Click on Allow or Deny as per your preference.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.mobileHeading: How to Enable/ Disable Web Push Service in Mobile Devices
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.androidStep1: Open Chrome browser and Click on Menu, under this section tap Settings.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.androidStep2: Scroll Down and click on Site Settings
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.androidStep3: In Site settings, again continue to scroll down and choose Notifications.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.androidStep4: In Notifications section, select the site you want to allow or deny web push services.
pushNotificationsEnableGuide.androidStep5: On the next screen, tap on clear & reset, a pop-up will appear asking for your permission to allow or Block notifications from the selected website. Choose the option as per your preference.
